1.consolidated_definition: Característica del ojo del gallo que ha perdido la vista. Consiste en permitir ver claro el fondo del ojo. Si tiene clarín, ha perdido la vista. Ponce.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Characteristic of a rooster's eye that has lost its sight, consisting in allowing the clear view of the fundus of the eye. If it has a clarín, it has lost its sight. Ponce.
